limitations: Historical per-call requests/responses, precise model snapshot, scorer artifacts, and aggregate-injection fixture were unavailable for independent replay.
The offline examples validate only deterministic local checks. They do not establish model visual accuracy, recall, precision, provider billing, or production extraction safety.
